subject: science
counting: corpusCount = occurrences at the start of a sentence or after a bracket across all 264 Standard Double Award Science question papers 2018-2026 under docs/sources/papers/science (text scan 2026-09-05; counts only). indexQuestions = questions tagged with the word in data/papers/questions-index.json. typicalTariff is per part in marks (science parts: median 2, 90th percentile 3-5 — packs/science/exam-true/tariffs.json), provisional until the topic-level miner runs.
legal: Command words reproduced as single words/short phrases; meanings, traps and coaching are ours.

words.meaning: Give the correct scientific name or term; no explanation.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One marking point per name; the listing rule applies.
words.trap: A correct name beside a wrong one scores zero; misspellings that become another word are not credited.

words.meaning: Write the fact, value or law briefly; definitions need the glossary key words.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One point per fact; two-mark definitions have a threshold point plus a qualifier.
words.trap: Hooke's law without 'limit of proportionality'; Principle of Moments without 'about a point' and 'in equilibrium'.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (State 362, Give 587); Summer 2025 P1 H MS Q1(a); research 03 §7.4

words.meaning: One scientific reason per mark, specific to the situation.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One point per valid reason; extra wrong reasons can invoke listing.
words.trap: Yield-loss reasons and nanoparticle risks must be the specification's own.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (Give a reason 16, Give two reasons 15, Give one reason 11, Why 48); research 03 §7.3

words.meaning: Give the meaning using the CCEA glossary wording.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Threshold idea plus qualifier.
words.trap: Atomic number 'including electrons'; isotopes defined in the singular; mass as 'amount of matter' not recalled.

words.meaning: Say what happens or what the data shows, in order, with values where there is data.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One point per feature or step; trend descriptions need numbers from the graph or table.
words.trap: Trends not taken from the graph; observations not fully qualified ('colourless solution').

words.meaning: Give the cause-and-effect chain using the specification's key words.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One point per link in the chain; the key word carries the mark.
words.trap: 'Carry current' instead of 'carry charge' (ions); 'less collisions' instead of 'fewer successful collisions per unit time'; filament lamp curve needs temperature → collisions → resistance.

words.meaning: Apply knowledge to an unfamiliar situation; any scientifically sound answer is credited.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One point per valid idea.
words.trap: Osmosis in new situations; unfamiliar contexts answered with memorised text.

words.meaning: Equation, substitution with converted units, answer, unit.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Typically [1] equation, [1] substitution, [1] answer, [1] unit; ecf after a slip.
words.trap: Wrong equation scores nothing; g→kg and minutes→seconds missed; answer not to the stated decimal places.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (Calculate 629, Work out 1); Summer 2025 P1 H MS Q1(b)(ii), Q4; research 03 §7.1

words.meaning: The named source must be used (graph reading, data table, Data Leaflet Ar values, an earlier answer).
words.whatEarnsMarks: Marks for the reading/values from the named source; ecf from an earlier answer.
words.trap: Graph values misread; Ar taken from memory instead of the leaflet.

words.meaning: Fill the table, sentence, diagram or equation from the information given.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Usually [1] each entry or [1] for all.
words.trap: Respiration written in both columns of a carbon-cycle table; totals read by summing table values.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (Complete 816, Add 58, Fill in 6); research 03 §7.2-7.3

words.meaning: Produce the formula or equation demanded; symbol equations are marked as reactants, products, balancing.
words.whatEarnsMarks: [1] reactants, [1] products, [1] balancing for symbol/ionic equations; [1] for a word equation or formula.
words.trap: Diatomic elements forgotten; symbols not case-sensitive; ionic and half equations 'continue to prove challenging'; names given instead of formulae.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (Write 585, Balance 11); Summer 2025 C1 H MS Q1(d)(i); research 03 §7.3

words.meaning: Produce the diagram: 2-D apparatus, ray diagrams with arrows and normals, circuit symbols, dot-and-cross, structures.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One point per required feature (rays, arrows, normals, labels, correct symbols).
words.trap: Lens rays not constructed; rays bent the wrong way; missing normals; 3-D apparatus; functional group circled with H atoms.

words.meaning: Add the names to the diagram at the indicated positions.
words.whatEarnsMarks: [1] each label (or one mark for a set).
words.trap: Focal point and ray direction arrows; anode/cathode.

words.meaning: Plot the points accurately and draw the best-fit line or smooth curve.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Scale, labels with units, points, line — each a point.
words.trap: Straight segments instead of a curve; axis label without unit; rates curve with the wrong finish.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05; Summer 2025 U7 Physics Booklet B MS Q3(a); research 03 §7.3-7.4

words.meaning: Take the reading from the printed scale or diagram, with unit.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Accuracy within tolerance (angles ±1°).
words.trap: 25° angle inclusion; reading to the wrong precision.

words.meaning: Pick out the item that fits from the information or diagram.
words.whatEarnsMarks: One point per correct identification.
words.trap: Listing.

words.meaning: Select from the printed options; one selection per answer.
words.whatEarnsMarks: [1] per correct selection.
words.trap: Contradictory ticks cancel ('+1/−1').
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05 (Circle 201, Place 133, Choose 96, Tick 89, Put a 11, Underline 1); research 03 §7.1

words.meaning: Give the required number of items.
words.whatEarnsMarks: [1] each or 'any two from'.
words.trap: Meteors/meteorites listed as orbiting objects; extra wrong items.

words.meaning: State how the two things differ (or agree) using comparative language, with values.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Comparative statements only; one-sided statements score nothing.
words.trap: 'Biggest clear area', 'killed the most bacteria' — comparatives with evidence.

words.meaning: Give the expected value or outcome from the pattern shown.
words.whatEarnsMarks: The prediction plus, where asked, the reason.
words.trap: Extrapolation without using the trend.

words.meaning: Give the test and its positive result for a substance or gas.
words.whatEarnsMarks: [1] test, [1] result.
words.trap: Benedict's needs heating; Biuret vs Benedict's; limewater result must say milky.

words.meaning: Instruction accompanying calculations: the working is where the method and ecf marks live.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Equation and substitution marks.
words.trap: Bare answers lose the intermediate marks when wrong.
words.source: corpus scan 2026-09-05; Summer 2025 P1 H paper Q1(b)(i)

words.word: In this question you will be assessed on the quality of your written communication
words.meaning: Marks the 6-mark QWC question (one per paper); banded marking.
words.whatEarnsMarks: Band A 5-6, B 3-4, C 1-2 by indicative points, then communication quality.
words.trap: Fragments without capitals and full stops; off-target content.
words.source: paper front pages ('Quality of written communication will be assessed in Question …', one per paper); packs/science/exam-true/qwc-bands.json

words.meaning: Question form; treat by tariff (1 mark = recall, 2+ = describe/explain/calculate).
words.whatEarnsMarks: By tariff.
